data.summary:
Seasoned Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience in Agile environments, with expertise in data-driven decision-making, process improvements, and business requirements gathering.
Strong skill set in taking complex data and converting it into actionable insights, technical specifications, and effective dashboards.
Experienced in stakeholder management, business process enhancement, and the delivery of solutions that are aligned to strategic objectives.
Committed to ongoing learning, mentorship, and driving cross-functional collaboration and Diversity & Inclusion.

responsibilities: Analyzed high-volume transaction and logo datasets using SQL (Snowflake) to identify reconciliation gaps, optimize match rate performance, and enhance overall merchant and customer experience across the network.
Led onboarding and technical integration of new merchants and logo partners, managing requirement documentation, data mapping, and activation cycles to ensure smooth production rollout.
Led business requirement gathering sessions and documented detailed BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process flows aligned with business objectives.

Worked across Agile SDLC, translating functional requirements into technical specifications while collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and defining test scenarios, acceptance criteria and supporting UAT.

Applying Advanced Excel tools including Macros, Pivot Tables, and advanced formulas to streamline transaction reconciliation, improve reporting accuracy, and support faster decision-making for match rate optimization.
Led Agile ceremonies to deliver BI solutions aligned with business KPIs, improving stakeholder satisfaction by 20%.
Designed interactive Power BI dashboards using DAX measures to track KPIs and enable data-driven decision-making.
Conducted as-is/to-be analysis, EDA, impact analysis, trend analysis, gap assessments to identify root causes of mismatches, recommending actionable improvements for reconciliation accuracy.
Collaborated with data and engineering teams to assess feasibility of analytics workloads on GCP (Big Query), supporting gap analysis and modernization discussions.
Maintained structured assessment documentation, findings, and risk logs to support cloud migration planning and stakeholder decision making.
Built predictive models (Regression, K-Means, ARIMA) that cut inventory stockouts by 18%.
Employed advanced Excel to provide precise, real-time reporting to enhance data quality between departments and facilitate 20% quicker decision-making.
Tracked system performance with Kibana, pinpointing causes of application errors and applying resolutions that minimized downtime by 30%.
Improved delivery pipelines utilizing CI/CD solutions like Jenkins and Bamboo, where Agile-based deployments are faster and release times decrease by 25%.
